textual.limitations: These records do not establish whether the coins were delivered, whether the offer was legitimate, or what referral conditions applied.

textual.limitations: The records do not identify the recipient, amount, transaction terms, or whether the step was mandatory for a specific program.

visual.limitations: These frames do not establish whether the claims are accurate, whether anyone registered, or whether any coins were actually paid.

visual.context: Account dashboard showing coin balances and unlock statuses.
visual.potential_relevance: Free coin accrual is presented with explicit unlock timing and conditions, linking the promised reward to a non-routine time-based condition.
visual.limitations: The frames do not establish whether the displayed balances were received, withdrawable, or valuable.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes CoinPro and USI-TECH-related participation through recurring coin-income claims and a referral-dependent network. The speaker describes daily free coins, directs viewers to a referral link and Facebook group, and encourages them to build a community or network to sustain themselves, while the displayed account shows referral levels and percentage-based rewards.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: S06 fits because the promoted earning opportunity uses multiple referral levels with percentage-based rewards and explicitly encourages viewers to recruit or build a network. The video connects participation and income to referrals rather than merely showing an ordinary one-level discount or referral code.
